label: Bible Study
prompt: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love _____ one another.
verse: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
note: Freedom isn't a license — Paul says its best use is serving one another.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our _____ into the way of peace.
verse: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
note: Zacharias, silent for months, gets his voice back and sings of a light that will guide our feet into peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a _____, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
verse: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
note: Michal watched from a window as David leaped and danced before the ark — and she was not a fan.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very _____ song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
verse: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
note: Ezekiel's audience enjoyed his preaching like a concert — and went home without doing anything.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: She hath done what she could: she is come _____ to anoint my body to the burying.
verse: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
note: Defending the woman with the costly ointment at Bethany: she anointed his body 'aforehand' for burial.
